textbookBox.concept: Simple present: she plays. Simple past: she played. Simple future: she will play.

beats.en: Simple present: she plays. Simple past: she played. Simple future: she will play.
beats.speakEn: Simple present: she plays. Simple past: she played. Simple future: she will play.

beats.en: Present continuous shows an action going on now: she is playing. Past continuous: she was playing. It uses is, am, are or was, were with the ing form.
beats.speakEn: Present continuous shows an action going on now: she is playing. Past continuous: she was playing. It uses is, am, are or was, were with the ing form.
